# WatchTrack coding instructions

Read the repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing. Follow the detailed project standards in [docs/ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md).

For UI work, consult the applicable upstream skill before implementation:
- [Apple Design Skill](https://github.com/dickwu/apple-design-skill/blob/main/SKILL.md)
- [Emil Design Engineering](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/emil-design-eng/SKILL.md)
- [Animate](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/animate/SKILL.md)
- [Review Animations](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/review-animations/SKILL.md)
- [Animation Performance](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/animation-performance/SKILL.md)
- [Mobile Native](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/mobile-native/SKILL.md)
- [Break UI](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/blob/main/skills/break-ui/SKILL.md)

Do not impose Apple-only conventions on the Android app. The APK uses the website UI inside a WebView, so keep website and bundled Android assets synchronized. Run relevant checks and report what was actually tested; never claim hardware testing without doing it.
